📖 How to use

  1. Write or paste your caption.
  2. Watch characters, hashtags (#) and mentions (@) counted live.
  3. Check the fold preview: only ~125 characters show before "… more".

❓ Frequently asked questions

How long can an Instagram caption be?

2,200 characters. Only the first ~125 show in the feed before the "more" cutoff, so front-load the hook.

How many hashtags can I use?

Up to 30 per post. This tool counts them live; 3–8 relevant hashtags usually outperform 30 generic ones.

Does the counter include line breaks?

Yes — every character including line breaks and emoji counts toward the 2,200 limit.
